question: What does dragging a row in the Layers list do to the blocks' z values?
how: real mouse input in headless Chrome on the demo page, nothing saved: Exit Without Saving after each run. Blocks: heading z 1, paragraph z 2, shape z 3. Rows front to back, center 47px apart, 44px high.
z: after a drop the blocks are numbered 1 to n, the front row highest. A removed block leaves a hole (1, 3) until the next drop
crossing: moving down, a row passes the next one when its bottom edge crosses that row's center: 10px no, 30px yes, and 72px passes two. Up is taken to be the same with the top edge; only -72 was tried

hold.ghost: the row follows the pointer in y, over everything, read from the shot: over white rgb(232, 241, 254), over the page color rgb(201, 178, 249), so about rgb(215, 230, 253) at .57, with a soft shadow
hold.slot: where it would land: a blue row rgb(72, 148, 255) with no content
hold.panel: stays put, the layers order in the section does not need a reload

undo: one undo per drop, back to Save disabled after one drop
notMeasured: whether the ghost also follows the pointer in x: ours does not
the distance before a press counts as a drag: ours uses 4px
whether the page's blocks change while held: ours changes them on the drop

panel.box: 240 by 500, 11px under the Layers button: 22,279 with the button at 224 to 268, and 22,132 with it at 77 to 121
